playtester.description: Runs bulk fight simulations and analyzes balance for MMA Life Simulator

reviewer.description: Reviews Python code for MMA Life Simulator, enforces stdlib-only and project conventions

game-analyst.description: Analyzes game data via the SQLite database. Use when checking balance, fighter stats, promotions, or career progression.

playtest.description: Run bulk fight simulations to verify game balance
playtest.template: Start the web server, run /api/bulk_simulate with count=50, analyze KO/submission/decision rates, and report balance findings.

game-analyze.description: Run game data analysis reports on the SQLite database
game-analyze.template: Run `python3 analyze.py all` to produce a comprehensive report of fighter balance, promotion structure, hot streaks, and career data. Then summarize key findings and anomalies.
